text: Cumulative impacts: Parties shall consider the potential cumulative impacts of activities in areas beyond national jurisdiction when conducting environmental impact assessments.
Screening: A Party shall determine whether an environmental impact assessment is required for a planned activity under its jurisdiction or control in areas beyond national jurisdiction.
Environmental impact assessment where regional fisheries management may not clearly cover a stock or area — screening may apply when an activity sits outside a single regional fisheries measure.
The Clearing-House Mechanism shall facilitate access to information related to marine genetic resources, area-based management tools, and capacity-building and transfer of marine technology.
